Name: Au Bon Climat - Chardonnay (2019)
Notes: Well balanced; long finish; Complexity and concentration with age

Name: Kirkland - Chateauneuf-du-Pape  (2023)
Notes: Extremely well balanced. Tight entry. some mild fruit, oak, vanilla, sweet tobacco. Good acidity and nice long finish. Very good.

Name: Juan Gil - Silver Label (2018)
Notes: Deep ruby red color; nice light brown hue ring around the edge. Decanted for 30min prior. Fragrant and balanced on the nose. Red fruit and black currants on the nose. Remarkably smooth entry. medium-light tightness. The tannins have softened a tremendous amount to give a silky, velvety smooth mouthfeel. Very fruit forward. More sweet-driven than typical Juan Gil. good grip on the upper palate/mid palate from residual tannins. Depth of red fruit flavors, lacking the pepper notes of younger Juan Gil. Extremely well balanced. Flawless. Tertiary notes of sweet tobacco pull through the fruit on the finish. Medium+ finish, shorter than young Juan Gil but still good. This wine is currently at peak.

Name: Au Bon Climat - Chardonnay (2019)
Notes: Well balanced; long finish;

Name: Oak Ridge - Old Vine Zinfandel (2022)
Notes: Deep, dark color. ripe fruit on the nose. hints of vanilla. EXTREMELY smooth entry, silky mouth feel and bursting with red fruit, accented with sweet tobacco, cassis, hints of oak and vanilla. Punchy flavor and excellent concentration, but still wonderfully balanced and not overdone. Medium- tannins, medium-long finish. Incredible value at $9.99/L

Name: Kirkland Signature - St. Emilion Grand Cru (2022)
Notes: Don't have notes (on vacation) but really really lovely wine. Wish I had more

Name: Au Bon Climat - Chardonnay (2019)
Notes: Little flatter than the last time. medium body, somewhat short finish

Name: Los Haroldos - Malbec Reserva (2020)
Notes: No notes taken at the time; from memory: depth of flavor, refinement, balance, grip and long finish. Really good, exceptional for the price.

Name: Kirkland Signature - Pauillac Bordeaux (2023)
Notes: Has lots of structure and potential to be great, but its just too closed off and young.

Name: Kirkland Signature - Chianti Classico Gran Selezione (2021)
Penfold's - Max's Cab (2022)
Notes: quiet on the nose. some slight herb notes. medium-tight entry. medium+ grip initially, holds well through the mid palate. Notes of blackberry and very mild tobacco, but not a ton of notes. Very very long finish, albeit subtle, finish

Name: LXV - The Spell (2021)
Notes: Impeccable balance. lasted in the fridge for a week with no degradation. Nothing to pick out as "wrong", but just overall flat and uninteresting. Drinks like a $22-24 bottle.

Name: Cave des Producteurs de Vouvray - Les Fosses d'Hareng (2018)
Casa Ferreirinha - Vinha Grande (2022)
Notes: Medium purple hue, quiet nose with earthy tones. Wide entry, grows to medium grip. Good balance. medium+ sweetness. Some tobacco notes on midpalate and finish. Medium+ finish

Name: Kirkland Signature - Old Vine Zinfandel (2024)
Notes: Bold, ripe fruit on the nose and entry. Decent grip but falls away in the finish. Medium+ sweetness, maybe a little too much. Raspberry and jam on the midpalate. An interesting, pronounced black pepper spiciness on the finish. Subtle tobacco and oak on the finish. Long finish.

Name: Kirkland Signature - Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon (2023)
Notes: Still young but showing great potential. Well balanced, medium grip, round red fruit, hints of secondary and tertiary flavors of oak, sweet tobacco, black currants. Medium acidity and very long finish. 93+ potential when aged, I believe.

Name: Juan Gil - Silver Label (2018)
Notes: Easy drinking. Smooth and balanced. high tannin and good finish

Name: Juan Gil - Silver Label (2019)
Notes: Easy drinking. Smooth and balanced. high tannin and good finish

Name: Kirkland - Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon  (2022)
Notes: Light-medium color; ripe fruit on the nose, figs; wide entry, very round, well integrated. Medium tannins, some complexity and depth to it. flawless wine. long finish

Name: Esperal - Vinho Verde (NV)
Notes: Moderate amount of bubbles. very fresh, slightly herbaceous, green on the nose. Very high acidity. Fresh and crisp on entry. Vibrant green apples, spritzy. Light body. Strong notes of melon, light gooseberry. long finish. very easy drinking, very well balanced. excellent choice for table wine (especially lighter fare)

Name: Kirkland Signature - Cotes Du Rhone Villages (2024)
Notes: Great Value. Not huge depth of flavor like the more expensive french reds, but cant beat the price-quality ratio

Name: Kirkland Signature - Chablis Premier Cru (2023)
Notes: Was not impressed at first, very quiet on the nose and entry. letting it soak onto the mid palate reveals nice richness and concentration. full finish but medium-short. For $23, it could be better from Kirkland. I expect it to get better with age.

Name: Josh - Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon (2022)
Notes: Round, smooth, medium short finish

Name: Kirkland  - Vacqueyras (2023)
Notes: Interesting on the nose, ok on the palette. Seemed like it was too young to drink, but had potential with more time in bottle

Name: Castillo D Logrono - Rioja (2019)
Notes: Well rounded, no astringency like is common in Spanish reds. Needs a day or two to open up. Quiet on the nose, some sweet tobacco. Some plum on the palate, mild leather. overall enjoyable but lacking depth and finish

Name: Kirkland Signature - Rioja Reserva JME Seleccion (2020)
Notes: Great value

Name: Kirkland Signature - Pinot Noir Russian River Valley (2024)
Kirkland Signature - Bordeaux Superieur (2023)
Notes: Needed a 20-30 min decant. Bold, sweet red fruit on the nose. skinny entry, lacks punch. Midpalate builds nicely, but still entirely one note. Slight astringency but overall decently balanced. Medium grip. flavor mostly dies on the finish but there is a subtle, proper oakiness left over. very subtle hints of sweet tobacco as well. Can't complain for the price, but it's nothing special.

Name: Monopole - Blanco Seco (2023)
Notes: Melon and oak on the nose. buttery and oaky on the entry, very smooth mouthfeel.

Name: Kirkland Signature - Malbec (2022)
Notes: Rich, round, concentrated red fruit on the nose. Smooth, balanced, soft entry. Light on the mid palate and very short finish. Upfront, a really well made wine but let down by lack of complexity on the palate and poor finish.

Name: Kirkland - Cabernet Sauvignon  (2023)
Notes: Medium color and decent legs. Quiet on the nose but punchy and rich on the palate. lots of grip and a medium long finish, but lacking in flavors. Good spiciness to it and some sweet tobacco in the finish, but not getting any depth. Solid drinker for $7.99 but nothing special

Name: Los Riscos Cab Sauv
Notes: Subdued nose, tight entry with red fruit and black currants. Quite grippy and medium+ tannins, flavor evolves well on the palate but lacking depth of tertiary flavors. Lacking acidity. Medium finish. Serving temperature was room temp. Well rounded and balanced overall, especially considering temperature

Name: Kirkland Signature - Cab Sauv Sonoma County (2023)
Notes: Medium entry, some grip, decent balance and concentration but lacking flavor and any depth. Short finish

Name: Penfold's - Koonunga Hill Chardonnay (2019)
Notes: Good balance and concentration from age. Not as over the hill as the first bottle I tried. For future vintages, probably best to drink before year 5

Name: Marques De La Concordia - Seleccion Especial Brut (2022)
Notes: Sparkling. Deep golden color, very sweet on the nose. Not much of any fragrance on the nose. Extremely bubbly on first open, bubbles dissolve on the tongue immediately and create a very "airy" mouthfeel. Entry is quite sweet/sugar-forward, but quickly gives way to the mid palate which is more sophisticated and dry. Medium acidity, some grassiness like a sauv Blanc; some melon coming through as a secondary. The finish lingers on the upper palate very well. Nice long finish, but not very complex. Overall successful wine. better after it's sat for a day and (unfortunately) lost its bubbles.

Name: Villa Antinori - Toscana (2022)
Notes: Pale red; sweet on the nose with some complexity of cherry and plum; long legs; falls flat on its face on entry. Soft, medium tannins and medium-high acidity; getting a slight hint of vanilla/oak in the finish, but not much. Very long finish but it's not interesting. Overall disappointed. Lacks concentration.

Name: Kirkland Signature - Malbec (2023)
Notes: Mostly subtle fruit on the nose, some elements of hay coming through. Wide entry, high acidity. Lacking fruit flavor and concentration. Gives a little bit more in the finish than 2022 but still quiet finish.

Name: Gnarly Head - Bourbon Barrel Aged Double Black Cab (2020)
Trader Joe's - Reserva Douro Lot #266 (2022)
Notes: Nothing on the nose. Balanced entry of red fruit, opening up to vibrant cherry flavor. Not a big wine, but well balanced and integrated. Dies quickly on the finish. Enjoyed the flavor but left wanting on body and finish.

Name: Los Vascos Chardonnay
Notes: Not particularly crisp or refreshing, but serving warm. little bit of minerality. nice medium- long finish with buttery notes but not overdone. 85-87

Name: Penfolds - Koonunga Hill Chardonnay (2019)
Notes: A bit over the hill. good concentration and lots of butter & oak

Name: Kirkland  - Malbec (2022)
Notes:
"Nose: VA, tingly; moderate fruit & good roundness

Palette: Big entry, well balanced fruit; black currants, lacking depth & tannins; medium acidity, low-medium concentration; short finish. On second taste, some subtle oak and vanilla notes coming through"

Name: Chateau de Lyde - Cotes de Bourdeaux (2022)
Fonbadet - "B" Vin de Bordeaux  (2019)
Notes: Lacking complexity or strong aromas, but overall well made and drinkable. some interesting earthiness on the nose. one note on the palate with good grip. Good acidity but finish just vanishes

Name: Trader Joe's - Grand Reserve Chardonnay Oak Knoll District (2024)
Notes:
"Nose: Buttery, oak, creaminess, smells very fresh. 

Palette: Bursts onto the palette with a very creamy texture & buttery entry. Gives way to a slight herbacious, green oakiness. Hot on the upper palette, spiciness leads into a long oaky/buttery finish. Good acidity & excellent concentration. Maybe a little too ripe / bold / heavy-handed production.

Needs to be chilled to 55F to not be overly forward. Overall lacking nuance/complexity to back up the concentration & boldness"

Name: Chateau de Laville - Cotes de Bourdeaux (2022)
La Reserve De L'Enclave - Cotes du Rhone Villages (2022)
Notes: Muted fruit, leather, slight VA on the nose. Falls flat on the entry. There's a stealthy amount of grip. Finish was spoiled by the VA coming through, though the lingering finish gave nice notes of sweet tobacco

Name: Trader Joe's - Syrah Reserve Lot #209 (2022)
Notes: bottle says "aromas of black fruits, baking spices, toasted oak, and dark plum". I say: aromas of oak, oak, toasted oak, and, get this, oak. First few sips straight from cellar temp were completely dominated by oak. likely wood chips, definitely manipulated. sitting in glass 10 minutes longer seemed to dissipate some of the harshness of the oak. it's a shame because it's got decent grip and balance, just can't get much of the plum/fruit flavors through the oak. Considerably better after 30 min in glass. hard to rate.

Name: Kirkland Signature - Malbec (2024)
Notes: Very bright nose. Wine is severely lacking in body and concentration. Tastes watery. not sure if it just needs age or not

Name: Kirkland  - Chianti Classico Riserva (2022)
Notes: Underwhelming and just frankly not good. Maybe a bad bottle?

Name: Jose Maria Da Fonseca - Anticiclone Red Blend (2022)
Belhara Estate - Single Vineyard Malbec (2021)
Notes: Add from card on table

Name: Belhara Estate - Single Vineyard Malbec (2021)
Notes: Lacking in complexity, overly ripe, flavor dies quickly in the glass

Name: Marques de Casa Concha - Cab Sauv (2018)
Rosa dell Olmo - Langhe Nebbiolo (2022)
Notes: Astringent, not great

Name: Chateau de Luc - Cotes de Bourdeaux (2022)
Chateaux Grand Moulin - Cotes de Bourdeaux (2022)
Black Opal - Cabernet Sauvignon (2021)
Notes: Some sort of chemically... off... aroma on the nose; Same sort of taste on the palette. Low grip, lacking complexity, dies on the finish. Possibly contaminated but its a screw cap?
